title: Cell Puller #8 Metric – Tool: Wrench, Cell Puller
description: No need to ever ruin the threaded studs on your Saft Batteries. Use this cell removal tool. It is designed to be threaded onto the stud of the cell. A quick, easy pull is all you need to then remove the cell. The puller provides all the leverage you will need. Manufactured by Saft for Saft Batteries Call for Price and Delivery- Special Order Item See Also BS1074M and BS1075M
